claim_under_screen: Task-relevant role/context interaction of the unchanged quantum relation scorer might distinguish its contribution from generic nonlinear label-wise attention.

inputs.marked_input: M(tokens,entities), with @ subject and # object punctuation before the frozen encoder
inputs.hidden: H(tokens,entities)=wordmean(RoBERTa(M(tokens,entities))); marks excluded from pooled words but can affect contextual word vectors
inputs.explicit_roles: R(tokens,entities): clipped signed relative distances/32 plus two membership bits

task_premise: A candidate natural-pair analysis would require actual labeled train-only rows sharing original tokens but using different ordered entity pairs; their marker-conditioned H may differ. Existence/count/semantic suitability of such groups is unmeasured. No assumption of independent views, unchanged H, inverse-label map or quantum realizability.
endpoint: For a fixed class pair r,s, m(H,R)=z_r(H,R)-z_s(H,R), with actual signed values, decoder and bias included. The same r,s must be used in every factorial cell. All40class competitors remain necessary for correctness/Macro claims.
interaction: I=BB-BA-AB+AA; known finite factorial difference, no novelty claim
prediction_under_screen: A nonzero I, or I persisting after fixed-value replay, could uniquely support quantum role/content interaction.
competing_explanation: Classical role-only attention times context-dependent values already gives I; additive content+role logits followed by softmax give I even with fixed values. Both are legal relation_softmax interface constructions.

case_1.description: Role-only softmax scores and H-dependent values. Real two-token subject swap gives second-token probabilities1/3 and2/3 with score coefficient ln2; word values(0,1) for H_A and(0,2) for H_B.

case_2.description: Fixed values(0,1), additive content/role logits. Use subject-score coefficient ln2/2 and content log-odds ln2/2,3ln2/2, yielding AA/AB/BA/BB log-odds0,ln2,ln2,2ln2.

decision_rule: A legal nonquantum counterexample rejects the claimed discriminating prediction before any model/data admission. Marker-only source checks do not prove numerical hidden-state changes or task utility.
boundaries: Crossed AB/BA cells are path interventions, not newly labeled natural entity queries.
Uniform ignores explicit R but receives entity-marked H; it is not entity-blind by construction.
No model/encoder forward, data access, training, private arrays, rank demo, stopped-family revival or new formal run.
Elementary factorial algebra/softmax examples are tools, not nontrivial new theory or L5.
